item.title: Alan M. Turing (1950) — Computing Machinery and Intelligence
item.dc:creator: Alan M. Turing
item.description:
Reading sequence: A — Foundational texts.

Citation: Turing, A. M. (1950). Computing Machinery and Intelligence. Mind 59(236), 433–460.

Why read: Turing's imitation game is a foundational proposal for discussing machine intelligence through language interaction. It is directly relevant to non-anthropocentric standards for understanding and language ability.

Question: To what extent does the imitation game assume human linguistic performance as the standard for machine intelligence?

Open full-text HTML: readable edition.

Original-layout PDF: PDF.

DOI: 10.1093/mind/LIX.236.433
